checks.detail: The command uses --train-after-preflight. The controller verifies preflight_complete, empties the preflight phase list, then runs train followed by formal. It reacquires the existing single flock -n GPU lock separately around each runner subprocess and waits for each child; the launcher adds no nested lock. The controller rechecks proof and capacity before training.

checks.detail: Each arm's preflight and full spec differ only in output root. Between arms the only differences are root, support_arm, fused_support and reused_control_root. Full training compares all 6887 initial recognition records and every one of the 3723 fit batch row orders to its reference, then requires the 29778 fit rows exactly once with no holdout overlap.

The old G control only supplies the raw arm's initial/order reference; it does not replace the paired same-tail raw control.

checks.detail: Both real preflights serialize 346613523 bytes, making the existing per-arm requirement 827444774 bytes.
